updates.title: Global Minimum Tax package updates GIR and peer-review framework
updates.summary: The Inclusive Framework released updated Global Minimum Tax implementation materials, including an updated GloBE Information Return, a full legislative review framework and further administrative guidance.
updates.business_impact: In-scope groups should assess whether reporting data models, GIR mappings and local filing processes need to change for fiscal years beginning on or after 31 December 2025.
updates.client_question: Is the current Pillar Two data model ready for the revised GIR and jurisdictional review process?

updates.title: Albania ratification brings the STTR convention into force from 2027
updates.summary: The OECD reported that Albania's ratification brings the multilateral Subject to Tax Rule convention into force from 1 January 2027.
updates.business_impact: Groups with covered intragroup payments to developing jurisdictions should monitor treaty changes and model possible source-country tax exposure.
updates.client_question: Which intragroup payments could become subject to additional source taxation under the STTR?

updates.title: EU Customs Reform enters into force
updates.summary: The European Commission states that the new EU Customs Reform has entered into force and will be implemented gradually, including a more data-driven customs architecture and changes for e-commerce.
updates.business_impact: Importers, e-commerce platforms and customs teams should map process, data and systems changes against the implementation timeline.
updates.client_question: Which customs data and operating-model changes need to be prioritised before the next implementation milestones?

updates.title: Commission consults on VAT rules for the circular economy
updates.summary: The Commission launched a consultation on aligning VAT rules with circular business models, including second-hand goods, destruction of viable goods and passenger-car input VAT deduction.
updates.business_impact: Retail, mobility and circular-economy businesses may have an opportunity to influence future VAT design and should assess where current rules create friction.
updates.client_question: Which VAT rules currently constrain circular or reuse-based business models?

updates.title: HMRC urges Trader Support Service users to prepare for platform migration
updates.summary: HMRC announced that all goods movements from 20 October must be submitted through the new Trader Support Service platform for movements between Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
updates.business_impact: Affected traders should complete pre-enrolment, permissions and testing before the cutover to avoid disruption in customs declarations.
updates.client_question: Are all GB–NI traders, agents and permissions ready for the new TSS cutover?

updates.title: UK CBAM guidance updated ahead of 1 January 2027 start
updates.summary: HMRC updated its Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism material. UK CBAM is scheduled to apply from 1 January 2027 to specified carbon-intensive imports.
updates.business_impact: Importers should identify in-scope goods, test registration thresholds, establish emissions data flows and assess landed-cost impacts.
updates.client_question: Which imports cross the UK CBAM threshold and where will emissions data come from?

updates.title: OECD Tax Policy Reforms 2026 compares reforms across 92 jurisdictions
updates.summary: The OECD published Tax Policy Reforms 2026, comparing tax reforms introduced or announced in 2025 across 92 jurisdictions.
updates.business_impact: The report provides a cross-country baseline for identifying jurisdictions where corporate, consumption or investment tax changes may affect group planning.
updates.client_question: Which jurisdictions in the group footprint are moving materially away from the current tax baseline?
